based_on: Northbridge Windows Enterprise Environment, scenario version 1.0 (course-supplied)
disclaimer: Fictional teaching environment. All records are simulated. Changes from v1.0 are listed in environment/CHANGES.md.

field_definitions.data_classification: restricted_pii (banking, salary, HR) | pii (contact, order history) | general | none
field_definitions.data_protection: protected = encryption at rest AND access limited to named groups AND access logging; unprotected = any of these missing or undocumented; n/a = no PII
field_definitions.exposure: internet (directly or through proxy/WAF) | intranet (reachable from USERS or VPN zones) | internal_only (restricted zones only) | isolated (no normal network path)
field_definitions.priority_override: Reason the asset is forced to P1 regardless of the matrix, or null
field_definitions.low_priv_local_access: true if a non-administrator account can run code or log on locally (interactive, RDP or service account); false if only administrators; null if unknown

zones.purpose: Directory, DNS, DHCP and online PKI
Standard wired and corporate Wi-Fi clients

flows.purpose: Named application servers to production SQL
Staff to business services, file shares, RDS
Remote staff to approved business services
Payroll operators to legacy finance application (assumption A15)
Scoped directory services for domain-joined devices

flows_note: Derived from the v1.0 document's summary of main paths. Reconcile flow IDs with the 16 flow records in the official windows_enterprise_environment.json.
default_policy: Deny unlisted inter-zone traffic and unsolicited Internet ingress (S02)

assets.notes: Two HQ, two recovery site. No public LDAP or RDP.
Normally powered off; excluded from routine network reachability. Patched when last powered on (2026-06).
Separate admin accounts; user endpoints cannot reach these hosts.
Internet-exposed indirectly through WAF (N03) and reverse proxy (L01). 12,000 customer accounts.
Payroll export and reconciliation for 1,000 employees. Payroll operators (non-admin) log on to run exports.
Sensor heartbeat older than 7 days; patch state cannot be confirmed.

business_services.consequence: Loss of authentication, unauthorized identity changes or broad privileged access
Delayed fulfillment, invoice tampering or loss of customer order data
Payroll disruption or disclosure/change of banking and HR data
Loss of service or contact and order-history exposure
Work interruption or confidential document disclosure
Loss of recovery capability can amplify a separate outage

evidence.title: Asset register
facts: 1000 endpoints, 60 server VMs, 6 hypervisors, 32 appliances, 40 APs, 30 printers
evidence.limitations: Cohort level; does not assert identical settings on every host.

evidence.title: Network design and reviewed access policy
facts: Unlisted inter-zone traffic and unsolicited Internet ingress denied by default
No Internet-facing RDP, SMB, LDAP, SQL or appliance management
evidence.limitations: Summarized flows; not a deployable firewall config.

evidence.title: Control and exception register
facts: SMB signing not required on FILE04; SMB1 disabled across W05
Twelve E02 sensors stale; ten E02 devices have local admin exception
W15 vendor exception retains NTLM for a service account; password last rotated 180 days before snapshot
W15 patch approval recorded 60 days before snapshot; installed KBs unknown in v1.0

evidence.title: Telemetry coverage summary
facts: AD, M365, firewall and VPN logs retained 90 days
Twelve E02 sensor heartbeats older than 7 days

evidence.title: Business impact and recovery worksheet
facts: Identity outage blocks new logins for 1000 staff
ERP supports 300 staff; outage > 4h delays orders and invoicing
Finance holds payroll and banking data for 1,000 employees
evidence.limitations: Synthetic RTO/RPO targets; not risk ratings.

evidence.title: Absence declaration
facts: Asset register complete at cohort level

evidence.title: Group scenario adaptation: assumptions A1-A15
evidence.limitations: Group assumptions, not scenario facts. Lower confidence when decisive.

evidence.title: Group scenario adaptation: version and patch data
facts: OS builds, last cumulative update months and software versions per asset, using real vendor release numbers current as of 2026-10-01
Other Windows Server 2022 servers: build 10.0.20348.5622 (September 2026, KB5122882), except offline root CA at 10.0.20348.5256 (June 2026)
E02: 28 devices at 10.0.19045.7725 (September 2026); 12 stale-sensor devices unknown
W15: Windows Server 2016 build 10.0.14393.9512 (September 2026 update) per patch report dated 2026-09-30
evidence.limitations: Version assignment to Northbridge assets is simulated; version numbers are real releases.

unknowns: E02: OS build and patch state of the 12 devices with stale sensors
W15 and FILE04: encryption at rest
Certificate template permissions and enrollment settings
